boarding_robot_mk1.name: Drill Robot
boarding_robot_mk1.notes: A boarding robot (docs/DRONES.md section 6): a hostile unit in the crew sim of the ship it was dropped into (ship.intruders, scripts/crew/intruders.gd). It fights crew in reach, otherwise walks to the nearest powered system and wrecks it. Mk II ion-locks the system. It never comes home.
